_comment: Copy to agents.json (gitignored) to change your crew. project = which chamber the agent works in (agents sharing a project share a chamber). role "boss" puts the agent in the middle HQ chamber as the big mech. model is shown on the name plate. look = optional character look: with the Tech Dungeon pack 0-3 are enemy mobs (crawler, spider walker, two turrets), 4 is the hover NPC and 5-12 are the player characters. Leave it out and each worker gets the next unused look; repeats (tinted with the agent's color) only start once every look is taken. color = name tag color.
